parameters.name: End1_Measurement
parameters.label: End1 Measurement
parameters.db_description: Is the measurement the adapter's outside or inside diameter?

parameters.name: End1_Length_mm
parameters.label: End1 Length (mm)
parameters.db_description: Length of the start connector, including the flange

parameters.name: End1_Rotation
parameters.label: End1 Rotation
parameters.db_description: Rotation around the z axis. Useful for non symmetrical connectors

parameters.name: End1_Taper
parameters.label: End1 Taper
parameters.db_description: Taper of the start connector, use negative to taper other direction

parameters.name: End1_Extension_Exit_Diameter
parameters.label: End1 Extension Exit Diameter
parameters.db_description: Inside diameter at the extension exit. 0 keeps the connector diameter. The change is tapered at 45 degrees

parameters.name: End1_Extension_GridSize
parameters.label: End1 Extension GridSize
parameters.db_description: Size of the grid in the extension. 0: diameter/6

parameters.name: End1_Extension_GridWallThickness
parameters.label: End1 Extension GridWallThickness
parameters.db_description: Size of the grid walls in the extension. 0: no grid, -1: uses wall thickness

parameters.name: End1_Extension_SlipRing_Support
parameters.label: End1 Extension SlipRing Support
parameters.db_description: Add breakaway supports to the slip ring gap

parameters.name: End1_Extension_SlipRing_Support_Spacing
parameters.label: End1 Extension SlipRing Support Spacing
parameters.db_description: Approximate spacing between supports around the selected opening

parameters.name: End1_Extension_Stop_Symmetrical
parameters.label: End1 Extension Stop Symmetrical
parameters.db_description: Should the stop be tapered both sides. Might easier to print

parameters.name: End1_Barbs_Thickness
parameters.label: End1 Barbs Thickness
parameters.db_description: Thickness of the barbs, default is half wall thickness

parameters.name: End1_Barbs_Symmetrical
parameters.label: End1 Barbs Symmetrical
parameters.db_description: Should the barbs be tapered both sides. Might be easier to print

parameters.name: End1_Hose_EndCap_GridSize
parameters.label: End1 Hose EndCap GridSize
parameters.db_description: End cap grid size for holes

parameters.name: End1_Hose_EndCap_GridWallThickness
parameters.label: End1 Hose EndCap GridWallThickness
parameters.db_description: Thickness of the walls in the end cap

parameters.name: End1_Hose_Enable_Threads
parameters.label: End1 Hose Enable Threads
parameters.db_description: Enable threads Thread side matches Measurement side. Beta feature does not work with taper

parameters.name: End1_Flange_Width
parameters.label: End1 Flange Width
parameters.db_description: Width of Flange added to the connector diameter

parameters.name: End1_Flange_Screw_Position
parameters.label: End1 Flange Screw Position
parameters.db_description: Position of the screws added to the connector diameter, 0 = middle of flange

parameters.name: End1_Flange_Screw_Border
parameters.label: End1 Flange Screw Border
parameters.db_description: Minium amount of the material around the magnet holes(mm), 0 = End1_Flange_Width / 4

parameters.name: End1_Magnets_Count
parameters.label: End1 Magnets Count
parameters.db_description: Number of magnets in the connector

parameters.name: End1_Magnet_Border
parameters.label: End1 Magnet Border
parameters.db_description: Minium amount of the material around the magnets (mm)

parameters.name: End1_Magnet_ZOffset
parameters.label: End1 Magnet ZOffset
parameters.db_description: Raises the magnet so it is fully enclosed (mm)

parameters.name: End1_Magnet_Flange_Roundover
parameters.label: End1 Magnet Flange Roundover
parameters.db_description: Round over the outside edge of the magnetic flange

parameters.name: End1_Magnet_Twist_Lock_Size
parameters.label: End1 Magnet Twist Lock Size
parameters.db_description: Magnetic ring Twist lock bolt size (draft setting)

parameters.name: Transition_Style
parameters.label: Transition Style
parameters.db_description: tapered for hose connections, flat for attaching to a device

parameters.name: Transition_Length
parameters.label: Transition Length
parameters.db_description: Length of the transition between the two ends

parameters.name: Transition_Angle
parameters.label: Transition Angle
parameters.db_description: Angle of bend through the transition section

parameters.name: Transition_Bend_Pipe_Diameter
parameters.label: Transition Bend Pipe Diameter
parameters.db_description: Select the bend pipe's inside diameter from the two ends, or enter a custom value

parameters.name: Transition_Custom_Bend_Pipe_Diameter
parameters.label: Transition Custom Bend Pipe Diameter
parameters.db_description: Inside diameter of the bend pipe when custom is selected

parameters.name: Transition_Offset_x
parameters.label: Transition Offset x
parameters.db_description: offset for the connector, not supported on taperedbend (x)

parameters.name: Transition_Offset_y
parameters.label: Transition Offset y
parameters.db_description: offset for the connector, not supported on taperedbend (y)

parameters.name: Transition_End2_Count
parameters.label: Transition End2 Count
parameters.db_description: Duplicate the second connector. Adjust angle and bend radius to make it work

parameters.name: Transition_HullCenterHeight
parameters.label: Transition HullCenterHeight
parameters.db_description: MulitConnector, center connector height. default is 2*lengthInHull

parameters.name: Transition_Base_Type
parameters.label: Transition Base Type
parameters.db_description: Include a flat section on the transition to assist with printing

parameters.name: Transition_Base_Width
parameters.label: Transition Base Width
parameters.db_description: Support Base Width, Default is half diameter

parameters.name: Transition_Base_Length
parameters.label: Transition Base Length
parameters.db_description: Support Base Length Default is 2/3 diameter

parameters.name: Transition_Base_Angle
parameters.label: Transition Base Angle
parameters.db_description: Support Base Angle position, default half of Bend Radius;
